name: Saskatchewan Aids to Independent Living
shortDescriptionEnglish: Saskatchewan Aids to Independent Living (SAIL) provides assistance to people with physical disabilities to live a more active and independent lifestyle. It also helps people in the management of certain chronic health conditions.

agency.name: Health
agency.description: The mandate of the Minisitry of Health is to provide leadership and vision for the health system in order to protect and improve the health of Saskatchewan people.  The Ministry, in a variety of partnerships, carries out this mandate by establishing policy direction, setting and monitoring standards, providing funding, supporting district health boards and ensuring the provision of essential and appropriate services to Saskatchewan residents.
